npcs.name: Jezra Brassbite
npcs.description:
Jezra Brassbite is a Relicborn theorist awakened from an ancient reliquary-core, their “severed head” less a machine part and more a preserved artifact vessel full of fragmented memories, old calculations, and spiteful survival instincts. As a Setrimir-shaped artificial being, they carry the strange inheritance of stolen knowledge, awakened purpose, and relic-born consciousness, making them brilliant, rude, precise, and absolutely convinced that most living people are inefficient arrangements of panic and fluids.
At the Heth'vára Transit Yard, Jezra works with the Regent Lattice as a consultant on rogue constructs, relic systems, divine-residue logic loops, and ichor-corrupted safety protocols. They claim their brutal theories are “mercy by mathematics,” but their fixation on preventing suffering by removing choice, risk, or occasionally the patient makes them useful, terrifying, and best kept far away from unsupervised triage.
npcs.settlementAndAncestryTexture: Heth'vára is a Town in Drakmorren, under Oligarchy, with high danger, Beach and grass with water, Mountain range, Beach and reefs with water terrain. Local records favor Neutral, Lawful, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Dwarf — Mountain Dwarf, Gnome — Rock Gnome, Goliath. Relicborn reads through the Relicborn entry of the race compendium, within Constructed and Artificial Beings, marked by Setrimir. Constructs awakened from ancient artifacts or forgotten relic systems, Relicborn carry fragmented histories within their forms. They are enigmatic and often driven by buried purpose. Table cues: Dance of Death, Eternal Party, Moment of Remembrance, Soul of Revelry; starting tendency Neutral - Lawful - Cooperative - Honorable.
rumors: Jezra Brassbite knows why an ichor ledger changed hands last Sigranday.
Jezra Brassbite has a contact in Thyralûn who will deny everything.

A rival faction offers proof that Jezra Brassbite's public story is incomplete.
